question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT imn.interest_name, MAX(im.composition) as max_comp
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN interest_map imn ON CAST(im.interest_id AS BIGINT) = imn.id
    GROUP BY imn.interest_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT interest_name, max_comp,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_comp DESC) as rank_desc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_comp ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM max_composition
),
max_values AS (
    SELECT imn.interest_name, im.composition as max_comp, im.month_year
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN interest_map imn ON CAST(im.interest_id AS BIGINT) = imn.id
    WHERE im.composition = (
        SELECT MAX(im2.composition)
        FROM interest_metrics im2
        JOIN interest_map imn2 ON CAST(im2.interest_id AS BIGINT) = imn2.id
        WHERE imn2.interest_name = imn.interest_name
    )
),
top_10 AS (
    SELECT 'Top' as category, m.interest_name, m.max_comp, m.month_year, r.rank_desc as sort_order
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN max_values m ON r.interest_name = m.interest_name
    WHERE r.rank_desc <= 10
),
bottom_10 AS (
    SELECT 'Bottom' as category, m.interest_name, m.max_comp, m.month_year, r.rank_asc as sort_order
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN max_values m ON r.interest_name = m.interest_name
    WHERE r.rank_asc <= 10
)
SELECT category, interest_name, max_comp, month_year, sort_order
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM top_10
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM bottom_10
) combined
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN category = 'Top' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    CASE WHEN category = 'Top' THEN sort_order ELSE sort_order END
